name: Icon
purpose: Display existing SVG artwork inline at a chosen pixel width while preserving its intrinsic aspect ratio and colors.

api.markup: Wrap the inline SVG in an element with class="icon".
api.size: Set --icon-size to any CSS length in pixels on the .icon wrapper. Defaults to 24px.
api.iconSelection: Choose an SVG from assets/icons and paste its SVG markup directly into the wrapper. No runtime file loading is used.

usage: Include icon.css and inline the unchanged contents of the selected SVG inside ….
accessibility: Mark decorative SVGs and their wrapper aria-hidden="true".
For a meaningful icon inside a named button or link, hide the SVG from assistive technology and provide the accessible name on the button or link.
If an SVG conveys standalone information, give the SVG role="img" and an accessible name with aria-label or a title element.
Do not use an icon by itself as an unnamed control.
color: The component does not set fill, stroke, or color. Existing artwork retains its source colors; currentColor is not added automatically.
fileProtocol: Works in static HTML opened with file:// because SVG markup is inline and no fetch or server is required.
